reviewFlags.issue: The store code is MQ100 CURRY. Braun writes it MQ 100 Curry, and the Israeli importer listing names only MQ100 with no colour code. Confirm the Israeli stock is the Curry colour variant.
Sources disagree on weight: Braun's manufacturer page gives 0.748 kg, while expert.ie lists 0.50 KGS. The catalog's 0.78 kg matches neither. Check the product label or manual before publishing.

The catalog's dimensions (height 39.5 cm, diameter 5.3 cm) were not confirmed on any fetched page. One unfetched search result gave 37.5 cm length and 7.2 cm width, which does not match. Measure the product or find a manufacturer spec sheet.
Israeli listings disagree on motor power. One search snippet (Shekem Electric, not fetched because it returned HTTP 403) gave 300W for the MQ100. Confirm the 450W figure with the importer.
The Israeli importer page names only MQ100, without Curry. Confirm the Israeli unit is the MQ 100 Curry variant.
The manufacturer gives 0.748 kg. expert.ie reportedly lists 0.50 kg, and the catalog's 0.78 kg matches neither. Published value follows the manufacturer.
The catalog's dimensions (height 39.5 cm, diameter 5.3 cm) were not confirmed by any source and should be checked or removed.
The two-year warranty quote comes from an importer page that does not name the model. Not published; confirm with the importer.
